verdict.rationale: Privacy posture around AI training is a fair question for any service that handles user data, including a crypto payments platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-use control for model training. Related items such as deleting a stored payment method or resetting a connection are adjacent data controls, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
